Counsel for Applicant :- Dr. Surendra Kumar Misra,Avnish Kumar Tiwari,Santosh Kumar Kana

sentences.text:
Counsel for Opposite Party :- G.A.
Hon'ble Pankaj Bhatia,J.
1.
Heard learned counsel for the applicant as well as learned A.G.A. and perused the record.
2. The applicant seeks enlargement on bail in FIR No.218 of 2023, under Sections 376, 452, 506 IPC, Police Station Neemgaon, District Lakhimpur Kheri.

entities.text: Police Station Neemgaon, District Lakhimpur Kheri
entities.label: ORG

sentences.text: 3. In terms of the FIR lodged on 15.07.2023, it was alleged that in the night of 10/11.07.2023, when the daughter of the informant was alone, the applicant came to the home and committed wrong on her.
In the statements under Sections 161 and 164 of Cr.P.C., the victim supported the said prosecution story, however, the medical on record does not corroborate the allegations.

entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: However, in the statement under Section 164 of Cr.P.C., the victim disclosed her age as 19 years.
4. Learned A.G.A. vehemently opposed the bail prayer.

5. Considering the inconsistencies in the statement coupled with the fact that the medical does not corroborate the allegation and there is substantial delay in lodging the FIR coupled with the fact that the applicant has no criminal antecedents and is languishing in jail since 15.07.2023, I am of the view that the applicant is entitled to be released on bail.
Accordingly, the bail application is allowed.

6. Let the applicant Anil be released on bail in the abovesaid first information report number on his furnishing personal bonds and two reliable sureties of Rs.20,000/- each to the satisfaction of the court concerned with the following conditions:
(a) The applicant shall execute a bond to undertake to attend the hearings;
(b) The applicant shall not commit any offence similar to the offence of which he is accused or suspected of the commission; and (c) The applicant shall not directly or indirectly make any inducement, threat or promise to any person acquainted with the facts of the case so as to dissuade him from disclosing such facts to the Court or to any police officer or tamper with the evidence.
